open scoped BigOperators
theorem study_d_unbounded_primes (n : ℕ) : ∃ p : ℕ, n ≤ p ∧ p.Prime
:= by

  then obtain p where p_def : p > n := this.elim

  exact ⟨p, p_def, p_prime⟩
end Nl2LeanCandidate
